data.one_liner: Pure Dart Cloudinary SDK for upload, admin, search, and signed delivery URLs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a complete Cloudinary client written in pure Dart with no Flutter dependency. It handles uploads, the Admin and Search APIs, and constructs signed delivery URLs.
use_when: You need to interact with Cloudinary from a Dart backend, CLI, or Flutter app.
You want to share your media code between Flutter and server-side Dart.
You need comprehensive coverage of Cloudinary's Upload, Admin, and Search APIs.
avoid_when: You only need to build delivery URLs and never call an API (use cloudinary_url_gen instead).
You prefer official first-party packages like cloudinary_api and cloudinary_url_gen.
strengths: Pure Dart with zero Flutter dependencies.
Complete coverage of Upload, Admin, and Search APIs.
Synchronous and pure delivery URL building.
weaknesses: Transformation DSL is less expressive than the dedicated cloudinary_url_gen package.
data.setup_notes: Requires a Cloudinary account. Set up your cloud name, API key, and API secret, or use unsigned upload presets for client apps.
